paragraphs.text: This is our family apple farm. We have many apple trees. The apples are big and red. My teddy sits on the grass.
paragraphs.translation: 这是我们家的苹果园。我们有很多苹果树。苹果又大又红。我的泰迪熊坐在草地上。

paragraphs.text: My name is Lily. I am six years old. I like apples very much. Teddy likes apples too.
paragraphs.translation: 我叫莉莉。我六岁了。我非常喜欢苹果。泰迪也喜欢苹果。

paragraphs.text: Today is a sunny day. My dad picks big red apples. My mom puts them in a basket. My little brother eats one apple.
paragraphs.translation: 今天是个大晴天。爸爸摘又大又红的苹果。妈妈把它们放进篮子里。我的小弟弟吃了一个苹果。

paragraphs.text: Teddy has a small red hat. He cannot pick apples. He can only look at them. He wants one sweet apple.
paragraphs.translation: 泰迪有一顶红色的小帽子。他不会摘苹果。他只能看着苹果。他想要一个甜甜的苹果。

paragraphs.text: I give Teddy a green apple. He holds it in his arms. He is very happy now. We sit under the apple tree.
paragraphs.translation: 我给了泰迪一个青苹果。他把苹果抱在怀里。他现在非常开心。我们坐在苹果树下。

paragraphs.text: One apple is on the ground. A little bird comes to eat. It likes the sweet apple too. We are happy in our orchard.
paragraphs.translation: 有一个苹果掉在地上。一只小鸟飞过来吃它。它也很喜欢这个甜甜的苹果。我们在果园里很开心。
